title: more-itertools: Bug report from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is more-itertools (an open-source Python library). Bug report from a user of this library:

> `more_itertools.one(it, too_long=MyError())` raises a plain `ValueError` instead of `MyError` when `MyError` instances are falsy (it defines `__bool__`). `only()` has the same problem, and so does `too_short`. A custom exception that was passed in must always be the one raised.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
